label: sglang
notes: target may use every CPU: llmperfscope shares CPUs with it

load.why: 1.1 CPU cores busy and the GPU 2% busy: host work, spread over threads that take turns.

warmup.why: 0.14 s is too short for the GPU's utilization counter. Use a longer run.

serve_c1.why: GPU compute is the limit: 93% busy. Use --nsys to see which kernels take the time.

serve_c4.why: GPU compute is the limit: 87% busy. Use --nsys to see which kernels take the time.

memory.text: The process holds 3.80 GiB of its own host RAM during serve, next to 5.85 GiB on the GPU. If that is a copy of the weights it can usually be released after upload.
The server's cache pool peaked at 1% (sglang:full_token_usage). Most of the memory reserved for it was never used at this load; a smaller reservation would fit, unless a heavier load is coming.

serving.text: Going from 1 to 4 concurrent requests raised throughput 2.89 times, and the median first token moved from 24 to 59 ms.

next_steps: --nsys: which kernels take the GPU's time, and what it waits on in the gaps
